claim_text: Across all available HLVid endpoints, mean question-micro accuracy was 0.5031 for K16 over six seeds, 0.4789 for K24 over three seeds, and 0.4913 for K32 over three seeds.
limitations: Unequal seed counts make these descriptive levels rather than the matched budget contrast

claim_text: For the three matched seeds, K16, K24, and K32 means were 0.4975, 0.4789, and 0.4913. Every 90% paired video-cluster interval included zero, so the evidence does not establish a reliable ordering or monotonic benefit from increasing K.
limitations: Video uncertainty for three shared seeds does not replace training-seed uncertainty

claim_text: Three validation-selected K16 policies each exceeded Center16 on the protected in-domain test split; mean coverage was 0.37107 versus 0.36163. The learned mean remained below the 0.43204 train-only Prior16 control.
limitations: Seed spread is available but not paired video uncertainty

claim_text: The calibrated variable policy used source-balanced mean K=15.156, outside the declared [15.5,16.5] matched-budget band (pooled frame mean K=14.571), and obtained 0.37875 coverage versus 0.41712 when the same endpoints were forced to K16; all three seed differences were negative.
limitations: Existing bundle lacks paired video uncertainty; source-balanced mean K is not pooled frame cost or measured encoder compute

claim_text: Actual content-dependent lengths improved coverage by 0.00776 over same-source shuffled lengths on the same per-frame forced-K36 ordering within each endpoint in all three seeds. This supports a small length signal but not a competitive joint selector.
limitations: The isolated signal does not rescue the worse combined policy

claim_text: The studies are complementary component analyses, not an integrated benchmark; their independent savings must not be multiplied.
The present-day requested-decode audit covered 77 videos and 268 questions with no unusable video, requested-read failure, metadata-count correction, substituted output or affected question row.
limitations: Reuse qualification only; historical certification is false; no claim that a decode audit verified live model execution.

claim_text: Some historical proxy settings retained similar observed HLVid QA with fewer candidate-grid frames; DINOv2 novelty and Uniform 128 had identical question-micro accuracy, while their video-macro estimates remain separately reported.
limitations: Observed similarity is neither equivalence nor equal-budget superiority. Historical source declares no primary metric; proxy information and costs differ; repeated test exposure.

claim_text: The five recorded Pixel-MSE thresholds show non-monotonic QA as retained frames decrease; the apparent peak at .04 remains exploratory.
limitations: All thresholds were repeatedly inspected on HLVid; marginal QA intervals and paired difference intervals are distinct.

claim_text: All 77 learned-policy video trajectories realized the same 48-frame schedule: starts (0,48,96), actions (32,32,16), with each action a gap after a kept 16-frame block.
limitations: MTV1 deployment differs from MTV48 uniform/fixed-gap QA references; no matched uniform-48 QA comparator. The collapse conclusion follows from trajectories, not the confounded QA difference.

claim_text: Historical timing is averaged over questions within actual cold-decode and frame-cache-hit strata; proxy time is included in total time. These records do not establish a controlled cache effect or end-to-end speedup.
limitations: Stratum counts/composition differ; query-free scores were recomputed per question; DINO diversity used another GPU and is excluded from H100 timing figures.

claim_text: The six-endpoint human K16 mean CLS distance was lower than the pretrained, random-mask and center means on the frozen panel. The pretrained and random paired 90% intervals include zero; the center contrast is below zero in the conditional descriptive analysis.
limitations: Three unadjusted exploratory contrasts;12 videos and6 fixed sources; six observed training endpoints and16 mask RNG seeds held fixed. Representation fidelity is not downstream QA.

claim_text: Cumulative ToMe r=15 and retained K16 both finish with 16 patches but have different layer schedules and analytical encoder costs. Temporary spatial merging restores 196 patches after every block. Same final token count is not same compute.
limitations: Matrix-multiply counts use FMA=2 and include dense patch embedding; matching remains separate and these are not full operator-profile or end-to-end counts.

claim_text: All three cumulative ToMe settings were faster than dense in the measured batch-16 protocol and slower than dense in the separate batch-one protocol. This is an implementation- and protocol-dependent observation.
limitations: Batch-16 amortizes 16-frame calls across12 videos; batch one uses two predeclared videos. K16 uses per-image ragged sequences. Selector inference and downstream heads excluded; fixed arm order precludes small policy-speed rankings.

claim_text: The 84 single-pass selector-export observations preserve operational cost evidence, with a cold first batch and no warmup/repeats; they are not a controlled selector-latency benchmark.
limitations: Own exporter environment and timing boundary; no uncertainty estimate, encoder-plus-selector sum or end-to-end speedup claim.
